issues.explanation: role is cast to UserRole enum, so strict comparison to string is always false and the owner's membership can be deleted via self-removal or by owner/admin.
Task requires a stored generated column but virtualAs creates a VIRTUAL column instead of storedAs.
Diff adds models, migrations, factories and policies but ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests for any requirement or authorization path.
Slug is derived from a unique company name without its own uniqueness guarantee, so distinct names can slugify to the same value and violate entities_slug_unique.
Policies resolve membership via $membership->entity->memberships() instead of entity_id, adding queries and breaking when the entity is soft-deleted (belongsTo excludes trashed).
Docs say ownership transfer updates the owner_seq column, but owner_seq is a generated column and cannot be written directly.
Entity fillable/migration/factory carry locale_default which is not in the task column list, though it was pre-existing in the schema docs.

conventions.evidence: docs/database-schema.md updated (docs/database-schema.md:431,438,447,456) and down() present (change.diff:381,414); but no tests despite TDD rule requiring every feature ships with a test (change.diff has no tests/)

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:21,38, app/Models/UserRole.php:130-140, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:218-247 clear names and small methods; minor duplication of membership-exists queries

requirements.evidence: Entity/role/policies/factories/docs mostly present (app/Models/Entity.php:21-41, app/Models/UserRole.php:137-140, docs/database-schema.md:447) but virtualAs instead of stored (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:408) and owner-delete check compares enum to string (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:183)

scope.evidence: Diff only adds entities/memberships/roles/policies/factories/migrations plus docs/database-schema.md and AuthServiceProvider registration; no routes/pages/session handling

security.evidence: EntityPolicy correctly gates view/update/delete/manageSettings (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:223-247) but EntityMembershipPolicy.php:183 if ($membership->role === UserRole::Owner->value) never matches enum-cast role, permitting owner-membership deletion

simplicity.evidence: Lean Eloquent relations/scopes/policies reusing hasMany/belongsToMany/whereIn (app/Models/Entity.php:26-41, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:76-89); some repeated exists() queries but no speculative layers

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ directory or *Test.php files; no coverage for persistence, single-owner constraint, factories, or unauthorized-call paths

review.summary: Change implements entities, memberships, roles, policies, factories and docs on the main path, but the owner-delete guard never matches due to enum-vs-string comparison and the one-owner column is virtual instead of stored, and it ships no tests.
